texte.L'article # du règlement demande des mes: Article # of the Regulation calls for appropriate technical and organisational measures: Annex A provides the inventory of them, and A.# expressly addresses the protection of personal data.
texte.La partie II de l'annexe I du CRA — trai: Part II of Annex I to the CRA — vulnerability handling and disclosure, software bill of materials — largely overlaps A.#, A.# and A.#.
texte.La structure harmonisée est identique :: The harmonised structure is identical: management review, internal audit, nonconformities, documented information and competence graft on without being redone.
texte.Le CRA compte des PRODUITS et impose un: The CRA counts PRODUCTS and requires CE marking, technical documentation and a report to ENISA within # h. A certified management system brings no product into compliance.
texte.Le RGPD porte sur les DROITS DES PERSONN: The GDPR is about the RIGHTS OF INDIVIDUALS — legal basis, information, access, erasure, portability — on which the standard says nothing. A perfectly certified organisation can process data with no legal basis.
texte.Les deux annexes A n'ont AUCUN rapport :: The two Annex A's have NOTHING to do with each other: # security controls on one side, # AI governance controls on the other. And the scope of the AI management system is not that of the security management system — carrying it over as it stands is the commonest mistake of this graft.
texte.Les dix mesures de l'article #, §#, trou: Nearly all ten measures of Article #(#) have a counterpart in Annex A: a certified management system is the most direct body of evidence an entity can put forward.
texte.Logiciels qui recherchent, suppriment ou: Software that searches for, removes or quarantines malicious software
texte.NIS # impose des DÉLAIS de signalement —: NIS # sets reporting DEADLINES — # h, # h, one month (art. #) — that the standard does not set, a PERSONAL liability of senior management (art. #), and registration with the authority (art. #(#)). No certificate covers those three.
